preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have exactly n characters and consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output string t must be a rearrangement of the input string s.
The palindromic count of the output string t must be greater than or equal to that of the input string s.
